headline: Sensex and Nifty end flat as crude oil concerns and US Fed caution cap upside gains

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Crude oil prices hovering near USD 115 capped upside potential for benchmark indices.
Caution ahead of the upcoming US Federal Reserve rate decision kept market sentiment cautious.
Selling pressure in major banking and IT stocks offset broader market gains.
Concerns over geopolitical headwinds in West Asia weighed on corporate earnings expectations.
whatHappening: Sensex and Nifty closed flat while the Nifty stayed below the 22,750 level.
Midcap and Smallcap stocks outperformed, with the Midcap index rising by 565 points and Media index jumping nearly 4%.
Coal India's H1 capital expenditure rose 27% to ₹7,966 crore, surpassing its target.
Reliance Industries scheduled its Q2 results for October 30 along with board consideration for fundraising.
summary: Indian benchmark indices closed flat as high crude oil prices and caution ahead of the US Fed meeting restricted market upside. Midcap and smallcap segments showed strength, with media stocks leading gains. Corporate earnings announcements and capex updates remained in key focus for investors.
